## Fucina degli Angeli: Peggy Guggenheim and 20th-Century Artistic Glass

14 November 2026 – 29 March 2027

[Find out More](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/exhibitions/fucina-degli-angeli-peggy-guggenheim-and-20th-century-artistic-glass/)

#### Welcome to the Peggy Guggenheim Collection, the Venetian home of a great collector. 
Discover the most important museum of European and American art of the twentieth century in Italy.

##### [Opening Hours](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/visit/)

Daily 10 am–6 pm 
Closed on Tuesdays and December 25 
The ticket office closes at 5 pm

**Tickets can be purchased online or at the museum's ticket office.**

[Subscribe to our newsletter](https://a2d4a7.emailsp.com/frontend/forms/Subscription.aspx?idList=10&idForm=6&guid=61ab244b-ca83-4dab-84ba-993754622669)

## Discover Peggy Guggenheim

[Find out more](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/art/in-depth/peggy-guggenheim/about-peggy/)

## In Focus

# [Applications are now open for the 2027 International Fellowship Program!](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/learn/international-fellowship-program/join-us-1/)

A unique and immersive learning experience for those wishing to pursue a career in the arts. 
[Find out more](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/learn/international-fellowship-program/join-us-1/)

# [At the Fucina! A Journey through Art, Craft, and Creativity for the Whole Family](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/support-us/membership/family/at-the-fucina/)

October 2026–April 2027

A workshop series with artisans, designers, and creatives that gives families the opportunity to learn about different techniques and materials, experiment with their own hands, and discover the value of making, research, and invention.

# [From Cubism to Abstraction: Mapping Peggy Guggenheim’s Modernism](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/support-us/membership/from-cubism-to-abstraction/)

November 2, 9, 16, 2026

An online course that, through the Peggy Guggenheim Collection, explores the major transformations of twentieth-century art, focusing on abstraction and Surrealism as the two key guiding poles for understanding international modernism.

# [Art from Africa in the Peggy Guggenheim Collection](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/art/in-depth/exhibitions/art-from-africa-in-the-peggy-guggenheim-collection/)

As Peggy Guggenheim recalls in her autobiography, in 1959 she purchased what she described as “twelve fantastic artifacts” from Africa, Oceania, and the Americas from the New York dealer Julius Carlebach, a collection she expanded throughout the 1960s.

# [One Hundred Years of _Cahiers d’Art_](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/art/in-depth/exhibitions/one-hundred-years-of-cahiers-dart/)

On the occasion of the centenary of the French journal **Cahiers d’Art**, founded in 1926 by art historian Christian Zervos, the **Peggy Guggenheim Collection** presents a special installation dedicated to the renowned publication in the galleries of the permanent collection.

# [Thursdays for Venetians](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/events/thursdays-for-venetians/)

On Thursdays, from 2 to 6 pm, the museum grants free admission to residents of the City of Venice and those born in Venice, as well as to students at Venetian universities.

# [Free Week for Venetians](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/events/free-week-for-venetians-2026/)

**From November 18–22** on the occasion of the celebrations of the Madonna della Salute, the museum grants **free admission to Venetian citizens**.

# [Listen to the podcast _I Wanted to be Free_](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/art/in-depth/peggy-guggenheim/i-wanted-to-be-free/)

“I Want to Be Free” is a podcast created by Chora Media and the Peggy Guggenheim Collection that tells the life story of the U.S. collector and her unconditional love of art.

## Become a Member

Support the museum’s programs and events by becoming part of a dynamic and passionate community.

[Become a member](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/support-us/membership/)

## Programs

# [A Scuola di Guggenheim](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/learn/schools/a-scuola-di-guggenheim/)

The educational program for schools of the Regione Veneto.

# [Dorsoduro Museum Mile](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/visit/dorsoduro-museum-mile/)

The Gallerie dell’Accademia, the Galleria di Palazzo Cini, the Peggy Guggenheim Collection, and Palazzo Grassi – Punta della Dogana have once again joined forces to create the Dorsoduro Museum Mile, a unique itinerary covering eight centuries of art and culture.

# [Accessibility Programs](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/learn/programs-for-accessibility-and-inclusion/)

The Peggy Guggenheim Collection guarantees accessibility to the museum’s spaces and content to everyone by welcoming visitors to a safe environment and organizing activities that promote social and cultural inclusion.

## Events

- [Upcoming Events](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/)

###### Workshop

# [The Characters of the Fucina](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/events/the-characters-of-the-fucina/)

Inspired by the works of the Fucina degli Angeli, this workshop invites children to transform a simple cardboard vase into a unique character through drawing, collage, and various materials, creating a three-dimensional vase cover that explores the transformation of an everyday object into a work of art.

14 November 2026 11:00 am

###### Tour

# [Meet the Curator](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/events/meet-the-curator-14-11-2026/)

On the opening day of "Fucina degli Angeli: Peggy Guggenheim and 20th-Century Artistic Glass," the curator leads visitors for a special guided tour.

14 November 2026 12:00 pm

###### Workshop

# [Kids Day: Traveling with Dorothy through the Peggy Guggenheim Collection](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/events/kids-day-15-11-2026/)

A free workshop for children aged 4 to 10.

15 November 2026 3:00 pm – 4:30 pm

###### Online course

# [Peggy Guggenheim and Venice](https://www.guggenheim-venice.it/en/whats-on/events/peggy-guggenheim-and-venice/)

The lecture focuses on Peggy Guggenheim in Venice and her collecting in the 1950s and 60s, including artists such as Marina Apollonio, Tancredi Parmeggiani, and Emilio Vedova, as well as her engagement with Murano glassmakers. It reflects on the collection as a whole and its relationship to Venice.

16 November 2026 7:00 pm

# Welcome at the Mart

Today open from 10am to 6pm

[Buy Tickets](https://www.mart.tn.it/en/tickets)

### Setup work at Casa Depero

On Tuesday, December 1st, setup work will take place at Casa Depero. Access for the public will, however, remain guaranteed.

### Ongoing Exhibition

Find out more about all the ongoing exhibition at Mart and Casa Depero in Rovereto and Galleria Civica and Palazzo delle Albere in Trento

[Learn more](https://www.mart.tn.it/en/ongoing-exhibitions)

### Education and cultural mediation

At the Museum and online

Mart is open to all: art welcomes, inspires and can be a great passion. The activities planned by the Education and Cultural Mediation Area are an opportunity for growth and exchange; a chance to stretch one's thinking and develop new skills.

[Learn more](https://www.mart.tn.it/en/educazione)

## Our collection

Torino was the first Italian city to foster a public collection of modern art as an integral part of its Civic Museum, which opened in 1863. 
The GAM collections consist of over 45,000 works including paintings, sculptures, installations and photographs in addition to a rich collection of drawings and engravings and one of the most important European collections of artists' films and videos.

[Read more](https://www.gamtorino.it/en/collections/)

## Education Department

The GAM Education Department wants to accompany the increasingly varied public to approach the rich artistic heritage and to familiarize themselves with the museum, taking advantage of training proposals, access facilities and articulated forms of pedagogical mediation for all citizens.

# M. K. ČIURLIONIS NATIONAL MUSEUM OF ART

The M. K. Čiurlionis National Museum of Art, established in 1921, is not only one of the oldest and largest museums in the country but also one of the most impressive examples of modernist architecture, included in the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2023. It is the only place in the world with the creative legacy of the most famous Lithuanian artist, composer, and public figure M. K. Čiurlionis (1875-1911). The paintings and graphics of this brilliant Lithuanian artist are exhibited in the modern renovated premises since 2003. In the Music Hall of the museum, you can listen to his music.

The museum offers an insight into nearly 600 years of the development of early art, reflecting the key trends in Lithuanian art and culture. Visitors can also discover Lithuania’s cultural heritage – the oldest works, as well as those that have preserved their forms unchanged for centuries, untouched by urban culture and the influence of industrial production.

In the museum’s inner courtyard, visitors are invited to explore a unique exhibition dedicated to traditional Lithuanian cross-crafting.

The museum also hosts various cultural events: concerts for children and professional performers, book presentations, lectures, seminars, scientific conferences, guided tours, and educational programs specifically made for children and youth. In the museum shop, the visitors can buy reproductions of M. K. Čiurlionis artworks, postcards, original souvenirs, various accessories, books.

# **Discover the Museum of Venetian Art**

Gallerie dell’Accademia, Venice

Walk through the galleries and let yourself be guided by the light of the great masters. 
From golden origins to eighteenth-century masterpieces, a journey that combines the rigor of time with the emotion of storytelling.

**Tickets**

## **Masterpieces**

#### **The Tempest**

##### **Giorgione**

The mysterious iconography has stimulated the most varied interpretations, also in relation to the meaning of the landscape and the sky torn by lightning that gives the painting its title.

#### **Saint Mark Freeing the Slave**

##### **Tintoretto**

The work represents one of the posthumous miracles of Saint Mark credited by hagiographic sources, namely Saint Mark freeing the slave from the torment of torture.

#### **Hermit Saints Triptych**

##### **Jheronymus Bosch**

A work of refined quality and extraordinary spatial conception, featuring the three hermit saints Jerome, Anthony, and Giles.

#### **Madame Letizia Bonaparte**

##### **Antonio Canova**

#### **Feast in the House of Levi**

##### **Paolo Veronese**

The work highlights Veronese’s extraordinary artistic achievements, skillfully combining elements of theatrical rhetoric with lively moments of sparkling conviviality within a monumental architectural setting.

#### **Polyptych of the Coronation of the Virgin**

##### **Paolo Veneziano**

A multi-tiered polyptych, with narrative scenes arranged around a central episode, framed by a sumptuous carved wooden framework with gilded decoration

## **Through eight centuries** 
**of Venetian art**

Eight hundred years of Venetian art contained in a single journey. From the golden icons of the fourteenth century to the light of the Renaissance, through to the masterpieces of the eighteenth century, the itinerary guides visitors through the evolution of art in Venice and its territory, following the thread of time.

[GO TO THE VISIT ITINERARY](https://www.gallerieaccademia.it/en/experience-the-museum/tour-routes/)

## **From the 14th to the 19th century**

#### **A journey through the centuries of Venetian art**

From fourteenth-century golden icons to nineteenth-century innovations, each stage reveals the evolution of the themes, styles and techniques that shaped the artistic history of Venice and its territory.

1300/1450 – GOLD AND GOTHIC

1450/1510 – THE RENAISSANCE

1510/1600 – MONUMENTALITY

1700/1880 – THE EIGHTEENTH-NINETEENTH CENTURY

## Significant Changes to MUŻA’s Permanent Exhibitions

The art galleries at MUŻA – The National Community Art Museum – are undergoing a transformation as significant changes are introduced to its permanent exhibitions. In recent weeks, efforts have been concentrated on the first-floor gallery, with the primary goal of offering visitors a broader and more immersive experience of art in Malta.

Heritage Malta remains committed to ensuring that the museum’s permanent exhibition continues to evolve, preserving and showcasing the contributions of Maltese artists. These changes will also strengthen MUŻA’s role as an educational hub, telling the story of Malta’s artistic heritage and the influences that have shaped it over time. The restructuring follows a chronological approach, tracing art from prehistoric times to the 21st century.

NGA 
[The international symposium "Bauhaus in/and the Baltics" is dedicated to the opening of the exhibition "vladas švipas: pušalotas > bauhaus > kaunas > new york", and the legacy of the Bauhaus in the Baltic States. The symposium will take place at the NDG auditorium on 9 October, Friday, from 3:00 to 4.30 p.m., The opening of the exhibition will start at 5.00 p.m.](https://www.ndg.lt/events/now/the-international-symposium.aspx) [Find out more >](https://www.ndg.lt/events/now/the-international-symposium.aspx)

[Find out more](https://www.ndg.lt/collection/the-collections-of-lithuanian-art-museum.aspx)

[Education](https://www.ndg.lt/education.aspx)

Education center is organizing various events for children, young people, school groups, families, adults and people with disabilities. We have a program raging from guided tours to workshops, meetings with professionals in art field, summer camps for children, integrated science and art lessons at the gallery.  

[Find out more >](https://www.ndg.lt/education.aspx)

[Visitor information](https://www.ndg.lt/visitor-information.aspx)

**NATIONAL GALLERY OF ART 
**Konstitucijos pr. 22, LT-08105 Vilnius, Lithuania 
T.: (8-5) 219 59 60; E-mail: info(at)ndg.lt

**OPENING HOURS:**

Tuesday 11.00-19.00 
Wednesdays 11.00-19.00 
Thursdays 12.00-20.00 
Fridays 11.00-19.00 
Saturdays 11.00-19.00 
Sundays 11.00-17.00

Closed on Mondays and national holidays. 
Closing time is one hour earlier on the eve of the national holidays.

Please note, that tickets are available till the last half of an hour before closure of the gallery.

Gallery is fitted for the needs of disabled people and families with carriages for children.

Entrance - on the ground floor, from the side of sculpture "The First Swallows" by J. Mikėnas

Take bus No. 30, 43, 52, 56, 89 or trolleybus No. 9, 19 to reach the gallery (exit at 'Nacionalinė dailės galerija' stop). The gallery is easily reached from the centre of Vilnius across the White or Green bridges.

The way to a parking-lot leads from Konstitucijos avenue or Upės str. (the way nearby "Forum Palace" currently is closed).

Art Information Centre and restaurant ["The Gallery"](https://www.facebook.com/restaurantthegallery) can be visited free of charge.  Restaurant ph.: +37060005452

**TICKETS:**

Regular entrance fee - 8,00 €

Entrance to the permanent exhibition only - 6 € 
On the last Sunday of each month, the gallery is free of charge.

Pupil, student and OAP - 4,00 € 
Child under 7, disabled, ICOM member - free.

Please note, that tickets are available till the last half of an hour before closure of the gallery. 

Reception ph.: (8-5) 219 59 60

**GUIDED TOURS**:

Tours in English language  - 35 € 
Information about guided tours and reservation ph.: (370-5) 219 5961 
E-mail: edukacija(at)ndg.lt

## Sightseeing suggestions

Discover our suggestions for exploring the museum’s branches. See the most important works in a single day, discover the lives of the greatest artists, or discover unusual works from bygone eras.

[**Wyspianski and Mehoffer**\\ \\ Learn more](https://mnk.pl/en/propozycje/wyspianski-i-mehoffer/)

Oddziały

- 
- 

- Number of works **8**
- Tour time **2,5-3 hours**

Łączyła ich więź przyjaźni, wspólnej pracy i rywalizacji; obaj studiowali razem w Paryżu oraz wynajmowali mieszkanie. Ścieżka poprowadzi przez świat krakowskiego modernizmu, ukazując twórczość dwóch najwybitniejszych artystów Młodej Polski – Józefa Mehoffera i Stanisława Wyspiańskiego. 

[Check the details](https://mnk.pl/en/propozycje/wyspianski-i-mehoffer/)

[**Power, Triumph and Remembrance**\\ \\ Learn more](https://mnk.pl/en/propozycje/wladza-chwala-pamiec/)

Oddziały

- 
- 
- 

- Number of works **8**
- Tour time **3-4 hours**

Ścieżka zwiedzania prowadzi przez trzy oddziały Muzeum Narodowego w Krakowie – Pałacu Książąt Czartoryskich, Arsenału oraz Domu Jana Matejki – ukazując, w jaki sposób sztuka przez stulecia budowała obraz państwa i pamięci narodowej.

[Check the details](https://mnk.pl/en/propozycje/wladza-chwala-pamiec/)

[**Wyspiański at Kraków**\\ \\ Learn more](https://mnk.pl/en/propozycje/wyspianski-at-krakow/)

Oddziały

- 
- 
- 

- Tour time **4-5 hours**

He was a painter, graphic artist and designer; he explored new avenues in literature and experimented in theatre. You’ll find traces of Stanisław Wyspiański all over Kraków, as the artist had a direct influence on the way we see the city.

[Check the details](https://mnk.pl/en/propozycje/wyspianski-at-krakow/)

[See all suggestions](https://mnk.pl/en/sightseeing-suggestions/)

## Discover the most important work

With over a million exhibits, each one tells a unique story, the National Museum in Krakow’s collection includes priceless works of painting, drawing, sculpture, graphic art, textiles, crafts, and material culture, as well as unique historical memorabilia.

[**Ways of Seeing. Collection of Muzeum Sztuki in Łódź**](https://msl.org.pl/en/ways-seeing-collection-muzeum-sztuki-lodz)permanent exhibition

**Ways of Seeing** is the new permanent exhibition of the Muzeum Sztuki in Łódź – a multifaceted narrative about 20th- and 21st-century art and about the museum itself as an institution of artistic experimentation, avant-garde thought, and solidarity. 

The exhibiotion focuses on the phenomenon of seeing – both as a biological function and as a cultural and political act. Divided into several thematic chapters, it presents art as a tool of inquiry, posing questions about how and why we look. Among the issues explored are: the relationship between vision and memory, the social contexts of looking, perception as a form of knowledge and a tool of resistance, as well as questions of identity, corporeality, and the sensorial experience of reality.

The exhibition open in **ms2**, 19 Ogrodowa St.

[**Suzanne Treister: Prophetic Dreaming**](https://msl.org.pl/en/suzanne-treister-prophetic-dreaming)current exhibition

_**Suzanne Treister: Prophetic Dreaming**_ **at Muzeum Sztuki in Łódź is the first retrospective in Poland dedicated to the work of this pioneer of digital art, new media, and net art. The exhibition spans over four decades of the artist’s interdisciplinary activity, presenting a practice that is visionary, radical, and critical, yet not devoid of humor.**

[**Gifts of Friendship**](https://msl.org.pl/en/gifts-friendship-0)current exhibition

The Gifts of Friendship exhibition presents nearly 150 works donated to the Muzeum Sztuki in Łódź collections in 2024–26 by nearly 100 artists from dozens of countries. It is one of the largest donations in the history of the institution, and one of the most important presentations of contemporary world art in Poland in recent years.

The exhibition open in two branches: **ms1** 43 Gdańska St. and **ms2**, 19 Ogrodowa St.

## Highlighted work

### 'Orchids' Diadem from René Lalique

This diadem is formed of two orchids in horn and one in ivory, embellished only by a small drop-shaped citrine in the central flower. The three-pronged diadem comb, also in horn, is connected to the diadem by a gold hinge.

[Learn more](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/works/orchids-diadem/ 'Learn more')

[- Audio / - Podcast / - 36 min\\ \\ **The Collection’s Journey to Lisbon**\\ \\ In the first episode of Sob o mesmo teto \[Under the Same Roof\], João Carvalho Dias and Vera Mariz follow the Gulbenkian Collection's route to Lisbon—from Paris, London and Washington, through wills that took decades to decode, tense diplomatic negotiations, and more than 1,200 crates.\\ \\ Sob o mesmo teto](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/the-collections-journey-to-lisbon/ 'The Collection’s Journey to Lisbon')

[- Article / - 7 min\\ \\ **Three Venetian sunk-panel bindings in the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum**\\ \\ In this text, Miriam Rampazzo describes her research process regarding three bindings from the Gulbenkian Collection, produced in the context of the Venetian Renaissance.](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/three-venetian-sunk-panel-bindings-in-the-calouste-gulbenkian-museum/ 'Three Venetian sunk-panel bindings in the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum')

[- Article / - 5 min\\ \\ **Cold case solved: Antoine-Jean Duclos’ erotic study of ‘Delirium’**\\ \\ In this article, Jane Turner, emeritus curator of the Rijksprentenkabinet in Amsterdam, recounts the discovery of the authorship of a drawing in the Gulbenkian Collection, the result of the collaboration between colleagues and institutions.](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/cold-case-solved-antoine-jean-duclos-erotic-study-of-delirium/ 'Cold case solved: Antoine-Jean Duclos’ erotic study of ‘Delirium’')

[- Audio / - 21 min\\ \\ **Especificalistas**\\ \\ What happens when we let children do the talking? Between January and June 2025, "Especificalistas", the Museum’s young critics, explored the Calouste Gulbenkian](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/especificalistas/ 'Especificalistas')

[- Article / - 7 min\\ \\ **On the hill of Montmartre**\\ \\ Montmartre, a reference for the bohemian life of 19th and 20th-century Paris, also became one of the favourite subjects for artists of the time. Marie Ely, curator at the Le Mans Museums, reveals which works in the Gulbenkian Collection feature representations of this neighbourhood.](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/on-the-hill-of-montmartre/ 'On the hill of Montmartre')

[- Article / - 6 min\\ \\ **The Collector in Vienna: A Study Trip**\\ \\ In this article, curator Vera Mariz examines the main aspects of Calouste Gulbenkian's journey to Vienna, where he found public and private collections that left him both enchanted and disillusioned.\\ \\ The Travels of Calouste Gulbenkian](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/the-collector-in-vienna-a-study-trip/ 'The Collector in Vienna: A Study Trip')

[- Article / - 5 min\\ \\ **The Collector’s Souvenirs: the Rothschild Medal Cabinets**\\ \\ Fifteen years separated Calouste Gulbenkian's initial observation of two works from the Rothschild collection and their eventual purchase. This article by curator Vera Mariz examines the story behind these acquisitions.\\ \\ The Travels of Calouste Gulbenkian](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/the-collectors-souvenirs-the-rothschild-medal-cabinets/ 'The Collector’s Souvenirs: the Rothschild Medal Cabinets')

[- Article / - 6 min\\ \\ **The museum out of the closet: unintentionally queer**\\ \\ In the final text of the series, André Murraças navigates the various chronologies and origins of the Gulbenkian Collection – from the Renaissance to the twentieth century, and from European painting to Arabic literature – bringing to light the various ‘queer’ narratives that can be found.\\ \\ The museum out of the closet](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/the-museum-out-of-the-closet-unintentionally-queer/ 'The museum out of the closet: unintentionally queer')

[- Article / - 5 min\\ \\ **The museum out of the closet: other possible facets to the Collection**\\ \\ In the second text of this series, playwright André Murraças explores the imagery of Antiquity and mythology in search of ‘queer’ stories hidden amidst the works of art of the Gulbenkian Collection.\\ \\ The museum out of the closet](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/the-museum-out-of-the-closet-other-possible-facets-to-the-collection/ 'The museum out of the closet: other possible facets to the Collection')

[- Article / - 4 min\\ \\ **The Egyptian pond: a dialogue between the Garden and the Museum**\\ \\ The link between the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum building and its surrounding Garden is well-known. However, these connections go beyond the museum gates, linking Ancient Egypt to today's fauna. Explore the relationship between the Garden and the Collection in this article written by curator Maxence Garde.](https://gulbenkian.pt/museu/en/read-watch-listen/the-egyptian-pond-a-dialogue-between-the-garden-and-the-museum/ 'The Egyptian pond: a dialogue between the Garden and the Museum')

## Magazyn MSN

[Read all Articles](https://artmuseum.pl/en/msn-magazine)

[**Processing the Unbearable, Imagining the Radical**\\ \\ 10.08.2026](https://artmuseum.pl/en/magazine/processing-the-unbearable-imagining-the-radical)

[**VASCULAR DIARY BY JUNE CRESPO**\\ \\ The book accompanied the artist’s solo exhibition "June Crespo: Vascular" at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao. The excerpts were selected as accompanying material for the exhibition "Sculpture Beyond the Solid" at the Museum of Modern Art in Warsaw.\\ \\ DIARY\\ \\ 15.10.2026](https://artmuseum.pl/en/magazine/vascular-diary-by-june-crespo)

[**Planet Piniak: The literary in the work of Piniak Przemysław**\\ \\ Piniak’s complete writings—not much more than a dozen short stories, one dramatic piece, several film scripts, audio shows, and “spoken” performance acts, uncollected notes, and recorded dreams—would make an average-sized volume, neither thin nor a tome. It is a non-existent volume, although perfectly imaginable.\\ \\ 13.08.2026](https://artmuseum.pl/en/magazine/planet-piniak-the-literary-in-the-work-of-piniak-przemyslaw)

[**Bureau of Mask Registry**\\ \\ African Objects in Polish Domestic Spaces, 1960–1990\\ \\ 12.06.2026](https://artmuseum.pl/en/magazine/bureau-of-mask-registry)

[**The Ethical Choices of Surrealists**\\ \\ The one significant absence from the exhibition is Salvador Dalí. It was he who cemented in the collective imagination the image of surrealism as a dreamlike vision, a Freudian puzzle presented with almost photographic literalness. We see relatively little of this kind of surrealism in the exhibition “In the Very Bowels of Changes.” For the exhibition’s focus is not on style, nor even on an artistic movement in the strict sense. Rather, it is about a certain attitude.\\ \\ 11.06.2026](https://artmuseum.pl/en/magazine/the-ethical-choices-of-surrealists)

[Read all Articles](https://artmuseum.pl/en/msn-magazine)

[**Publishing house**\\ \\ We publish books on contemporary art and culture and exhibition catalogs. We are developing several publishing lines: _mówi muzeum, kino muzeum, Muzeum w Budowie._\\ \\ Read more](https://artmuseum.pl/en/publishing-house) [**FRIENDS OF MSN WARSAW**\\ \\ The Association of Friends of MSN Warsaw conducts activities on behalf of the Museum of Modern Art in Warsaw.\\ \\ Read more](https://artmuseum.pl/en/association-of-friends-of-msn-warsaw)

# Encontro Clássicos com Companhia

2024-09-15

- [Encontro Clássicos com Companhia](https://museusoaresdosreis.gov.pt/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/encontro_acp_2024_3-1024x576.jpg)

O encontro Clássicos com Companhia realiza-se no 3º domingo de cada mês, no Velódromo do Museu Nacional de Soares dos Reis do Porto, com entrada pela [Rua de Adolfo Casal Monteiro](https://www.google.pt/maps/place/41%C2%B008'55.1%22N+8%C2%B037'22.0%22W/@41.148636,-8.622782,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m4!3m3!8m2!3d41.148636!4d-8.622782?entry=ttu).

Todos os interessados em participar só terão de comparecer com o seu carro clássico e juntar-se ao grupo para animadas conversas sobre um tema que a todos agrada. As histórias, os gostos e as experiências neste inesgotável mundo dos clássicos vão estar em cima da mesa, sempre na companhia de um café.

[Vista geral da instalação Valquíria Vénus, de Joana Vasconcelos, suspensa sobre um conjunto de manequins vestidos com peças de alta-costura da Maison Valentino. A obra combina grandes volumes têxteis iluminados em tons de roxo, dourado, vermelho, rosa, branco e azul, ocupando o centro do espaço expositivo.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/venus-valentino-garavani-through-eyes-joana-vasconcelos)

[Vista geral da instalação Valquíria Vénus, de Joana Vasconcelos, suspensa sobre um conjunto de manequins vestidos com peças de alta-costura da Maison Valentino. A obra combina grandes volumes têxteis iluminados em tons de roxo, dourado, vermelho, rosa, branco e azul, ocupando o centro do espaço expositivo.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/venus-valentino-garavani-through-eyes-joana-vasconcelos)

Exhibition

## VENUS – Valentino Garavani through the eyes of Joana Vasconcelos

Bringing together contemporary art and haute couture, the exhibition features iconic and newly created works by Joana Vasconcelos, conceived for MAAT and inspired by the creative universe of fashion designer Valentino Garavani (1932–2026).

[Learn more](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/venus-valentino-garavani-through-eyes-joana-vasconcelos)

[Cena de uma experiência de realidade virtual, com duas mãos virtuais em primeiro plano dirigidas a uma forma abstrata luminosa, composta por filamentos vermelhos, rosa, azuis e brancos sobre um fundo preto.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/life-game)

[Pessoa com óculos de realidade virtual num espaço imersivo, com uma mão levantada em direção a projeções abstratas de cores intensas em azul, rosa, vermelho e laranja que cobrem as paredes e o teto.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/life-game)

Exhibition

## Life is the Game – An immersive cine-poem directed by Paulo Furtado

Between death and rebirth, a timeless journey challenges perceptions of self and reality. Directed and scored by Paulo Furtado (The Legendary Tigerman), the mixed reality experience explores consciousness, identity, memory and transcendence.

[Learn more](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/life-game)

[Vista geral de um amplo espaço expositivo de paredes curvas brancas, com pinturas de diferentes dimensões e tonalidades distribuídas ao longo das paredes. Ao centro, uma grande estrutura escultórica branca com elementos escuros ocupa o espaço, sob um teto preto atravessado por linhas de iluminação.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/pedro-cabrita-reis-without-sorrow-heart)

[Vista geral de um amplo espaço expositivo de paredes curvas brancas, com pinturas de diferentes dimensões e tonalidades distribuídas ao longo das paredes. Ao centro, uma grande estrutura escultórica branca com elementos escuros ocupa o espaço, sob um teto preto atravessado por linhas de iluminação.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/pedro-cabrita-reis-without-sorrow-heart)

Exhibition

## Pedro Cabrita Reis – “without sorrow of heart”

Pedro Cabrita Reis presents a vast collection of series of paintings, drawings, and sculptures, created specifically for this exhibition that consolidates the artist's investigations and deepens his connection with the great themes and masters of post-Renaissance art.

[Learn more](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/pedro-cabrita-reis-without-sorrow-heart)

[Vista de um espaço expositivo de paredes brancas, com várias pinturas de diferentes dimensões. Em primeiro plano, uma instalação no chão é composta por uma grande quantidade de fragmentos de tijolo. Nas paredes destacam-se uma pintura predominantemente azul à esquerda e uma composição em verde, branco e amarelo à direita.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/turn-around-look-edp-foundation-art-collection)

[Vista de um espaço expositivo de paredes brancas com três obras: uma composição escultórica branca sobre fundo verde, uma pintura abstrata em azul, branco e preto e, ao fundo, uma pintura com grandes formas em tons de rosa, laranja, verde e azul.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/turn-around-look-edp-foundation-art-collection)

Exhibition

## Turn around. A look at the EDP Foundation Art Collection

The exhibition represents the largest presentation of the Fundação EDP Art Collection to date, bringing together around 90 works by 58 Portuguese artists, spanning from the 1960s to the present. On view until January 2027 at MAAT Central.

[Learn more](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/turn-around-look-edp-foundation-art-collection)

[Vista da instalação New Age, de João Pimenta Gomes, composta por estruturas metálicas refletoras dispostas numa galeria iluminada por luz laranja. As formas circulares e geométricas criam um ambiente envolvente de luz, cor e reflexão.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/joao-pimenta-gomes-new-age)

[Vista da instalação New Age, de João Pimenta Gomes, composta por estruturas metálicas refletoras dispostas numa galeria iluminada por luz laranja. As formas circulares e geométricas criam um ambiente envolvente de luz, cor e reflexão.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/joao-pimenta-gomes-new-age)

Exhibition

## João Pimenta Gomes – New Age

Sound, light and matter converge in an installation conceived for MAAT's Studio Space. Through resonant objects and sculptural forms, _New Age_ encourages a renewed awareness of space's sensory qualities.

[Learn more](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/joao-pimenta-gomes-new-age)

[Vista de uma galeria dedicada à produção editorial do MAAT, com mesas preenchidas por catálogos, livros e publicações organizados ao longo de uma cronologia que documenta a atividade do museu entre 2016 e 2026.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/exhibiting-publishing-maat-print-2016-2026)

[Vista de uma galeria dedicada à produção editorial do MAAT, com mesas preenchidas por catálogos, livros e publicações organizados ao longo de uma cronologia que documenta a atividade do museu entre 2016 e 2026.](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/exhibiting-publishing-maat-print-2016-2026)

Exhibition

## Exhibiting, Publishing: MAAT in Print (2016–2026)

Through a selection of more than 300 books, catalogues and other publications, this exhibition traces ten years of the museum's exhibitions, projects and programmes. A reflection on publishing as memory, record and an extension of MAAT's activity.

[Learn more](https://www.maat.pt/en/event/exhibiting-publishing-maat-print-2016-2026)

# Galerija Božidar Jakac

## Beyond Academia: Bosilj, Sekulić, Skurjeni, Tisnikar

25\. 09. 2026 – 28. 02. 2027

The exhibition Beyond Academia presents a comprehensive overview of the work of four exceptional painters from the second half of the 20th century: Ilija Bašičević Bosilj, Sava Sekulić, Matija Skurjeni, and Jože Tisnikar.

[Preberi več](https://www.galerija-bj.si/en/obcasne-razstave/onkraj-akademije-bosilj-sekulic-skurjeni-tisnikar/)

## Kristian Kožul: 1573. Fools, Villains, and Castles

11\. 09. 2026 – 14. 02. 2027

The exhibition of Zagreb-based artist Kristian Kožul showcases his most recent artistic production in a distinct ambience of former monastery church. As it is common in his practice, he uses a wide variety of sculptural materials, as well as he focuses on a specific historical as well as current and topical sociopolitical context.

[Preberi več](https://www.galerija-bj.si/en/obcasne-razstave/kristian-kozul-1573/)

## Artificial: Tin Dožić, Simon Goritschnig, Lara Reichmann, Andrea Zabric

25\. 07. 2026 – 31. 01. 2027

The group exhibition entitled Artificial focuses on the meaning of so-called artificial structures, materials, and worlds that appear in various realms of everyday life in the modern world.

[Preberi več](https://www.galerija-bj.si/en/obcasne-razstave/umetelno-tin-dozic-simon-goritschnig-lara-reichmann-andrea-zabric/)

## Guided Tour with Marko Košan of the exhibition “Beyond Academia” and a screening of the film “The Man with the Raven”

14\. 11. 2026 ob 16:00

Guided Tour with Marko Košan of the exhibition “Beyond Academia” and a screening of the film “The Man with the Raven” Saturday, 14 November 2026, at 4pm Marko Košan, curator of the The Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art Koroška, will conduct a guided tour of the works by Jože Tisnikar featured in the exhibition \[…\]

[Preberi več](https://www.galerija-bj.si/en/dogodki/11341/)

## Bogdan Borčić & Karel Zelenko: Dialogue

08\. 02. 2026 – 26. 01. 2027

On the occassion of the centenary of Bogdan Borčić’s birth and as part of the 20th exhibition in the Graphic Cabinet of Bogdan Borčić, the works of two great artistic companions, Bogdan Borčić and Karel Zelenko, are showcased in dialogue.

[Preberi več](https://www.galerija-bj.si/en/obcasne-razstave/bogdan-borcic-in-karel-zelenko-v-dialogu/)

Galerija Božidar Jakac – Muzej moderne in sodobne umetnosti je bil ustanovljen leta 1974, v njej je danes na ogled deset stalnih zbirk.

Guillermo Pérez Villalta, _Escena. Personajes a la salida de un concierto de rock (Scene. Figures Leaving a Rock Concert)_, 1979

Museo Reina Sofía

A museum's permanent collection is like its nerve centre, out of which all other messages emanate. The Museo Reina Sofía's Collection has been developing since 1894 and the foundation of the Spanish Museum of Contemporary Art, bringing together, almost a century later, all the state's various collections of modern and contemporary art. 

The Museo's Collection now comprises almost 25,000 pieces and spans the last decades of the 19th century through to the present day. The principal focus is the history of Spanish art but there is international work too, with a particular emphasis on Latin America.

## Marta Sanz sobre _Another pa amb tomàquet_, de La Ribot

La Favorita

This interview sees writer Marta Sanz (Madrid, 1967) discuss the work _Another pa amb tomàquet_ (2002), by the artist La Ribot (Madrid, 1962).

Sanz shines a light on La Ribot’s work and her ability to combine different artistic languages and place the body at the heart of aesthetic experience. The work simultaneously creates suspense, humour and a powerful visual richness, prompting a reflection on the female body, vulnerability and pleasure, and forms of women’s representation. The writer views the body as a metaphor that transcends the individual to approach social and political questions linked to identity, power and shared experience, also drawing parallels between La Ribot’s art-making and her own writing, particularly the use of the body as a tool of critique and reflection.  

This interview is part of _La Favorita_, a project which invites public figures to choose their favourite work from the Museo Reina Sofía Collections and share their personal history around it.

### Expansion project

## In 2025, work begins on the expansion of the MACBA at Convent dels Àngels. The project inaugurates a new phase for the museum, a MACBA that wants to grow in body and soul and become more inclusive, sustainable and transparent, in order to enhance the relationship between its buildings and the public space in Plaça dels Àngels.

## Exhibitions

### Opening the Archive 08. Le gros orteil.

The former will showcase Untitled (1930), the most recent work to be added to the Fundació Joan Miró Collection thanks to a donation from Françoise Marquet Zao.

### Charlotte Perriand. Free to Rethink the World

The first exhibition in Spain dedicated to Charlotte Perriand (Paris, 1903-1999), one of the most influential designers of the 20th century and a key figure in understanding the design of the Modern Movement.

### LED LIGHT

Last exhibition of _from 6:12 pm to 5:48 pm_, curated by Alejandro Alonso Díaz.

### Divided

It was very emotional: young couples with children, people enjoying a Sunday out, so traditional. I felt moved.»
